item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00016","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C10","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 is a highly plausible drafting template: it is an earlier Eisenhower letter to the Attorney General using the same Section 206-to-Section 208 sequence, nearly identical report and national-emergency findings, and the same operative instruction to petition a federal district court for an injunction and other appropriate relief. The child adapts that machinery to the Atomic Energy Commission dispute and adds facts concerning the discontinued and threatened renewed strike. C10 and C06 are earlier examples of substantially the same letter form, but C04 is closest in authorship, date, syntax, and operative structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"On July 6, 1954, by virtue of the authority vested in me by Section 206 ... I issued [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] creating a Board of Inquiry to inquire into the issues involved in a labor dispute","parent_excerpt":"On October 1, 1953, by virtue of the authority vested in me by Section 206 ... I issued [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], creating a Board of Inquiry to inquire into the issues involved in labor disputes","explanation":"The opening statutory recital and description of the prior Board of Inquiry follow the same drafting formula."},{"child_excerpt":"On July 10, 1954 I received the Board's written report in the matter. A copy of that report is attached hereto.","parent_excerpt":"On October 5, 1953, I received the Board's written report in the matter. A copy of that report is attached hereto.","explanation":"This report-receipt paragraph is reproduced almost verbatim with only the date changed."},{"child_excerpt":"In my opinion these unresolved labor disputes have resulted in a strike and threatened strike affecting an entire industry or a substantial part thereof engaged in trade, commerce, transportation, transmission or communication among the several States and with foreign nations","parent_excerpt":"In my opinion these unresolved labor disputes have resulted in a strike affecting an entire industry or a substantial part thereof engaged in trade, commerce, transportation, transmission or communication among the several States and with foreign nations","explanation":"The child closely copies the statutory finding while adding the threatened-resumption circumstance."},{"child_excerpt":"I therefore direct you, pursuant to the provisions of Section 208 ... to petition in the name of the United States any District Court of the United States having jurisdiction of the parties to enjoin ... such strike ... and for such other relief as may in your judgment be necessary or appropriate","parent_excerpt":"I therefore direct you, pursuant to the provisions of Section 208 ... to petition in the name of the United States any District Court of the United States having jurisdiction of the parties to enjoin the continuance of such strike ... and for such other relief as may in your judgment be necessary or appropriate","explanation":"The operative injunction direction uses the same legal machinery, sequence, and substantially identical language, adapted to a resumed strike and national-safety objective."}]}
